title: A successful transactional Mono waits for commit completion
summary: The transactional Mono now waited for the gated commit. A separate H2 connection saw zero matching rows at parent completion and one at merged completion.

change.description: The built-in operator uses a Mono-specific resource scope for the Mono overload. The parent adapts the Flux returned by `execute` through `next()`, which can cancel the upstream subscription after one element.

notes: The historical spring-tx operator wraps a JDBC-backed ReactiveTransactionManager. The read runs in the subscriber's completion callback at READ_COMMITTED, before the fixture releases any still-pending commit.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-tx 5.2.0.RC2. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
